record.title: Relay of Signals
record.desc: The Signalbearers #1 — Relay of Signals A new chapter in the Signature heroes universe: The call comes at shift change: deep orbit needs Illmir.. Starring Illmir (Tamere Ohal), Vavix (Galbex Setine). A team of cosmic guardians keeps the beacon-network of the far colonies lit — and something out in the dark keeps trying to snuff it.

pages.cap: The call comes at shift change: deep orbit needs Illmir.
pages.dlg: "the Rust Choir can't have gone far. Look for frost on the inside of glass."

pages.cap: But the Shattered Relay holds a surprise: a hollow signal wearing a person's voice.
The ghost tuner dims — time is running out.
pages.dlg: "Then we do it the loud way."

pages.cap: "We were the storm all Tavane" — the Rust Choir's words land like a dropped anchor.
Illmir leaps — for Velnara Prime, for Vavix, for everything.
Quiet, after. deep orbit glows in the aftermath.

record.note: An original generated comic created by the Signature system. All characters, places, and events are invented.
